text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Emir calls for an Arab summit to discuss implementing resolutions at the last summit in Cairo. He says it is necessary because of "obstinacy of Israeli prime minister" in setting up more settlements in Jerusalem.
- Gulf Air axes scores of employees, including Bahrainis, to cut costs.
- Finance and economy minister signs a $520 million loan contract with National Bank of Bahrain and City Bank to finance Hidd power and desalination project.
- Arab Banking Corporation posts $129 million net profit in 1996.
- National Bank of Bahrain to pay a 25 percent cash dividend to shareholders.
- Bahrain and United Arab Emirates sign a full-cooperation agreement in all fields relating to labour and social affairs.
